name: Cisco IOS XE Model-Driven Telemetry (tig_mdt)
what_it_is: A Docker-based TIG stack (Telegraf, InfluxDB, Grafana) pre-configured for Cisco IOS XE YANG Model-Driven Telemetry. It receives streaming telemetry from IOS XE devices via gRPC Dial-Out, NETCONF Dial-In, and gNMI Dial-In, stores data in InfluxDB, and visualizes it in Grafana.
components: Telegraf (collection) with cisco_telemetry_mdt and cisco_telemetry_mdt_netconf_dialin input plugins
IOS XE device (C9300/C9500/C9800 running IOS XE 16.10+)
configuration: IOS XE subscription via CLI: telemetry ietf subscription <id> with encoding, xpath filter, source-address, update-policy, and receiver
Telegraf NETCONF config: telegraf-netconf.cfg (server_address, username, password, redial interval)
TLS mutual auth config: telegraf-grpc-mtls.conf with tls_cert/tls_key
AAA: aaa new-model with privilege 15 user required for NETCONF
fault_injection: On-change subscriptions for OSPF neighbor state changes (ospf-neighbor-state-change)
On-change subscriptions for BGP peer state changes (bgp-peer-state-change)
On-change subscriptions for interface state changes (interface-state-change, interface-admin-state-change)
On-change subscriptions for IOS configuration changes (/ios:native, stream yang-push on-change)

Event types: memory-usage, cpu-usage, tempsensor-fault, fantray-fault, fan-fault, sdcard-fault, flash-fault, usb-state-change, sfp-state-change, system-reboot-complete, system-reboot-issued, system-login-change, system-logout-change, disk-usage
modes: gRPC Dial-Out (configured/static): device initiates connection to collector, subscriptions defined on device
NETCONF Dial-In (dynamic): collector opens session to device and sends subscriptions
gNMI Dial-In (dynamic): collector subscribes using STREAM/SAMPLE or ON_CHANGE mode
On-change update-policy (event-driven push on data change)
TLS/mTLS secured transport (optional, port 57501 for gRPC)
constraints: Requires IOS XE 16.10+ for gRPC Dial-Out; gNMI secure server requires TLS certificates loaded on device first
Power supply XPath (/oc-platform:components/component/power-supply/state) documented as non-functional on C9300 IOS XE 17.3
NETCONF dial-in requires AAA with privilege level 15 user configured on IOS XE device
Docker container exposes only ports 3000 (Grafana) and 57500 (gRPC); port 57501 (TLS gRPC) requires explicit mapping
gNMI insecure mode (gnmi-yang/gnxi without secure-server) does not support TLS — secure mode requires separate cert generation workflow
No docker-compose file in repo; single-container deployment only via docker run
docker_services: jeremycohoe/tig_mdt (all-in-one: Telegraf + InfluxDB + Grafana, Dockerhub image)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in repository; single docker run command only
No automated IOS XE device simulation or emulator included — requires real or lab hardware
No Splunk output configured by default (commented out in telegraf configs)
No Python-based subscription management scripts in repo (ncc tools are external)
No health-check or restart policy defined for the Docker container
No InfluxDB retention policy or data TTL configuration documented
